transfer_accounting.measurement_point: HfFileSystemFile._fetch_range return length, i.e. the HTTP response body of each range GET; excludes headers, TLS framing, redirects and path/size metadata calls, so it is a close lower bound on wire traffic rather than an exact wire measurement
transfer_accounting.prior_transfer_basis: calibrated estimate for the aborted attempt and probes; see PROTOCOL.md amendment B1

selection.plan: complete coverage of every eligible data file
selection.order_rule: numpy.random.default_rng(20260915).permutation over eligible files sorted by (split, chunk_index, file_index)

scope_statement: Frame-level conclusions cover exactly the four columns read from the files listed in processed_file_detail. No observed frame defect means no observed frame defect in that scope; it is not a claim that unread columns or other revisions are unaffected.
